rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: For balanced tensor cores activated on one control point, expand every entropy and influence term uniformly in the two parameters. Extract necessary asymptotic conditions on any claimed global potential.

deliverables.description: RARE_CORE_EXPANSIONS.tex: uniform two-parameter H/I and mismatch/KL expansions
POTENTIAL_NECESSITIES.md: necessary scaling for candidate global debts

acceptance_criteria: Keep tensor count and selector rarity independent until specifying the limiting regime; bound remainder terms uniformly in that regime.
Retain μ[log₂(1/μ)−D₂(ν||q)] from the existing mismatch/KL theorem and distinguish its local debt from the already paid 3μ/ln2 term.
Show which core H/I ratio survives activation and state that rare output or small I alone is FEI-strength, not a structural simplification.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A uniform asymptotic ledger identifies one concrete unpaid scaling term for A023/A026/A036/A048.

assignments.target_statement: Analyze Boolean seeds after one-point or adjacent-point flips, including bent and near-tensor seeds. Produce exact spectral formulas for the logarithmic terms that a local estimate would have to pay.

deliverables.description: POINT_SURGERY.tex: exact Fourier changes for one-point/adjacent-point Boolean flips
SURGERY_LOG_CERTIFICATE.md: logarithmic contribution and violation margin

acceptance_criteria: Specify the exact sign-valued truth table after each flip and retain both old coefficients and the signed perturbation.
Recover the bent-splice logarithmic control before claiming a new near-tensor family; include the interaction term for adjacent flips.
Separate an analytic parameter family from a finite numerical seed and identify precisely which local charge fails.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A reusable exact surgery formula plus either a new scalable failure or a proved cancellation mechanism.

assignments.target_statement: Develop a ledger paying a rare event once at its first revelation, with an explicit stopping rule and no reuse across descendants. Prove a complete bound for at least one nontrivial family.

deliverables.description: RARE_REVELATION_PAYMENT.tex: declared model family, stopping rule, and complete payment
RARITY_CREDIT_LEDGER.json: first revelation and descendant reuse accounting

acceptance_criteria: Own only the first-revelation rarity payment for a declared nontrivial family; A029 owns child-deficit transport and A064 owns the global potential.
Bound the complete expected sum of μ[log₂(1/μ)−D₂(ν||q)] plus terminal entropy, with each rarity credit spent at most once.
Exhibit a uniform bound on an unbounded parameter family and state whether its stopping rule is physical, adaptive, and finite.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete scoped amortization theorem, or a rigorously growing expected debt under the proposed rule, is required for renewal.

assignments.target_statement: Distinguish fair physical restrictions, whose remaining uniform inputs stay uniform, from changed inner-output means inducing biased outer-gate inputs in genuine disjoint composition. Track near-dictator and deterministic limits with the existing mismatch/KL rebate and the exact corrected FEI+ normalization; identify the credit needed to avoid unpaid rare logarithms.

deliverables.description: BIAS_TRANSPORT.tex: physical restrictions versus induced outer-gate biases
BOUNDARY_CREDITS.md: exact near-dictator and rare-child normalization terms

acceptance_criteria: A fair physical restriction leaves untouched originally uniform coordinates uniform; distinguish this from nonzero inner means inducing product biases at an outer gate.
At zero/one input probabilities reduce deterministic coordinates before normalizing biased Fourier atoms or dividing by I−Var.
Keep the mismatch/KL rebate and the corrected FEI+ normalization credit; do not charge a small child by an unsupported bounded scalar multiplier.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A precise reusable normalization/mean-transport interface is delivered; any weighted-threshold extension is assigned to A041.

assignments.target_statement: Turn a finite failure of a local charge into a rigorous parameterized Boolean family. State whether it refutes a constant, an all-coordinate rule, or a universal route; do not upgrade its scope.

deliverables.description: RARE_COUNTERFAMILY.tex: explicit Boolean sequence and asymptotic inequality
REFUTED_STATEMENT.json: original constant, quantifiers, and unaffected claims

acceptance_criteria: Give all dimensions and rarity parameters and prove the sign of the violation for a stated infinite range.
Retain the complete KL credit when refuting a candidate payment; a failure of a weaker scalar surrogate does not refute the stronger mismatch bound.
Explicitly distinguish a refuted local/all-coordinate rule from existential good-coordinate selection, an optimized tree, and FEI itself.

The accepted B05 fixed-price no-go is available as a completed first-instance artifact. Reuse its exact scope and move new effort to a distinct family or a constructive nonreusing tree payment; do not recount its reproof as a new result.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A parameterized certified local failure or a sharpened surviving scope closes the pilot.
